content: Session 2026-08-17: Investigated dummy packages wrapper vs symlink approach. Wrapper scripts broke efi-mkuki because rg doesn't support POSIX BRE (\+). Reverted to symlink approach. GNU grep removed (BusyBox grep used instead). Aliases removed from misc.go. Added Bin field to DummyPackageRule for binary name override. 480 packages installed, ~13% memory-safe. Harness 27/27 pass.
Ripgrep NOT a drop-in for grep: rg doesn't support POSIX BRE (\+). efi-mkuki uses grep with \+ for kernel version validation. GNU grep removed, BusyBox grep used instead.
